name: Indicator Value (Time)
description: This keyword will fetch the instantaneous value of any particular indicator in series at a particular time for an instrument. Since we are looking at instruments in series here, this keyword is used as a standalone keyword (not under position keyword).
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will fetch the instantaneous value of any particular indicator in series at a particular time for an instrument.  Since we are looking at instruments in series here, this keyword is used as a standalone keyword (not under position keyword).

![Example](./images/img-1632390895.png)

According to the example shared above, the Tradetron engine will check the value of the Upper Bollinger band at 10.00 AM for Nifty Bank 5 min candle. It is important to note that this keyword should only be processed after the time mentioned (has already passed). To ensure that one must use it in group with 'AND' condition as shown below:

![Example](./images/img-1632391127.png)

parameters.name: Indicator
parameters.description: Nested series/indicator keyword, e.g. Upper Bolinger(...).

parameters.name: Time
parameters.description: 'HH:MM' — the candle time to sample. Only valid once that time has passed (pair with a Time() AND condition).
